_doc: Experiment of Ch. 8 (application E on a 2x2 manycore, pkt-sim/software/ucx-os/app/weird_a.c). PE labels follow the log of commit 4c299fc; the analysis swaps X and Y of logs of the fixed RTL automatically. Times in seconds or cycles of the 500 MHz clock.

join._doc: rule per_producer: J runs iteration k after the k-th packet of each tag (weird_a.c of this tree); any3: J joins any packets_per_iteration packets (weird_a.c before 379f388, stored logs A to E; the Makefiles select it for these logs).

estimate._doc: Characterized task costs of rttools/bench_t/main.py: tasks of each cluster in dispatch order, cost in thesis scale (10 times weird_a.c), scheduler cost included in each cost. rttools/bench_t/estimate.py runs the ORT/BENCH engine on each list.

instrumentation._doc: Bound of the instrumentation writes in the measured CPU time (rttools/paper/instrumentation.py). callees: functions of device/cacc.c that write the registers of manycore_pe.sv. events: kind of logged event -> function that writes its register (set_counter_2 prints `scheduled`, set_counter_3 `->`, set_counter_4 `<-`), in charge order. cycles: cycles per instruction class of the HF-RISC core on the bus of manycore_pe.sv (no stall, no wait state), measured by pkt-sim/tests/rtl/tb_cpu_cycles.vhd.

task_graph._doc: Edges of application E (apps/synthetic-app-e/synthetic-app-e.txt), for the phase index of each task and the response bound.

thesis._doc: Values printed in the thesis (Ch. 8), in the units the thesis states.
